shadow_protocol.pairing_rule: For each approved new task, run the unchanged base version and the exact candidate version on the same frozen material set, in an environment and permission window declared before either run.
shadow_protocol.order_control: Record run order; if order can affect the task, counterbalance it or declare order as a limitation.
required_window_elements: material identifier, absolute source path or opaque package reference, content SHA-256, byte count, and freeze time
base version identity and candidate version identity
environment identity, permissions granted, and permissions denied
budget profile, cheap-request allowance, strong-request allowance, and automatic-retry allowance
window start, window end, timezone, and timeout behavior
task result fields, cost fields, failure fields, and evidence paths
reviewer/adjudicator identity where required by the protocol
shadow_protocol.severe_regression_stop_rule: Any verified severe regression, hard-gate failure attributable to the candidate, identity mismatch, budget/counting failure, or material/permission mismatch immediately disables the candidate for subsequent tasks and starts rollback. A stop is recorded; historical evidence is never deleted.
shadow_protocol.rollback_preservation: Restore the base identity, verify byte/mode/blob identity, re-run the predeclared base behavior check, and keep every task record and failed-run evidence unchanged.
shadow_protocol.evaluation_order: hard gates first; only after all hard gates pass compare benefit and cost.

technical_prerequisites.task_entry: A task enters shadow only after an owner-approved authorization_ref binds the task, material hash, permission window, and SHADOW budget window before either run starts.
technical_prerequisites.old_new_capture: The runner writes one immutable record per version under the same shadow_task_slot, with separate run IDs and identical material bindings.
minimum_capture: material SHA-256 before and after each run
exact command or adapter identity without secrets
stdout/stderr or structured result paths with SHA-256
review verdict and any stop/rollback event
technical_prerequisites.installation_boundary: Repository presence does not establish installation or loading. The current installation state is NOT_ESTABLISHED and the current loading state is NOT_ESTABLISHED; neither is inferred from tracked files.
technical_prerequisites.model_boundary: No model call is permitted while a required task window is absent.
